title: Poolside Desktop Assistant brings all your AI coding agents into one workspace.
description:
Poolside Desktop Assistant brings all your AI coding agents into one workspace.

Instead of juggling multiple terminals, you can run Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents in parallel across separate Git worktrees, keeping every task isolated and preventing conflicts between agents.

If you're building with AI every day, this is a cleaner way to manage multiple agents, repositories, and long-running coding workflows from a single desktop app.
